newsitem.title: USA: Russia reform payoff possible in 3-6 months - IMF.
newsitem.headline: Russia reform payoff possible in 3-6 months - IMF.

text.p: Reforms by Russia's new economic team could begin to pay off in three to six months, International Monetary Fund deputy managing director Stanley Fischer said Tuesday.

"The new russian team is really a remarkably good one and they have made a very determined start on dealing with these problems, particularly the revenue problem," Fischer told Reuters Financial Television.
"So that we are confident that the measures they have taken so far will begin to pay off, possible in three to six months," he said.
